# crouter Technical Specification & Architecture Manual (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive reference specification for `crouter` — universal model router, failover gateway, and credential isolation platform for Claude Code and coding agents.

---

## 1. System Architecture & Core Mechanics

`crouter` provides an audited, resilient routing layer between Anthropic Claude Code (or other coding agents) and diverse large language model backends. It solves three critical operational problems in autonomous AI development:
1. **Uninterrupted Agent Sessions**: Upstream rate limits (HTTP 429), quota exhaustion (HTTP 402), or temporary authentication failures (HTTP 401/403) trigger immediate in-flight candidate failover without dropping terminal sessions or restarting Claude Code.
2. **Quota Cooldown**: Unhealthy or exhausted credentials enter an automatic backoff cooldown, preventing subsequent agent tool calls from wasting retries on non-responsive backends.
3. **Zero Credential Contamination**: Environment sanitization (`env -i`) and macOS Keychain isolation prevent accidental leakage of proprietary API keys or Token Plan tokens into git history, terminal logs, or child subprocesses.

```
                              +---------------------------------------+
                              |   Client / Coding Agent Application   |
                              |   (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.)  |
                              +---------------------------------------+
                                                  |
                         ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (http://127.0.0.1:KEYPOOL/GATEWAY)
                         ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Session Client Token)
                                                  |
                                                  v
                              +---------------------------------------+
                              |         crouter Proxy Layer           |
                              |  - Direct Launch: bin/keypool-proxy   |
                              |  - Unified Gateway: bin/gateway       |
                              |  - Ollama Relay: 60s SSE Keepalive    |
                              +---------------------------------------+
                                    |                      |
                    Transparent Failover               Candidate Cooldown
                    (401, 402, 403, 429)               (300s / Retry-After)
                                    |                      |
                                    v                      v
        +-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
        |                              Upstream Providers                         |
        |  +--------------------+  +--------------------+  +--------------------+  |
        |  |  Token Plan Pool   |  |   Pay-As-You-Go    |  |  Local / Native    |  |
        |  |  (MiniMax, Qwen,   |  |   API Endpoints    |  |  (Ollama, MLX,     |  |
        |  |   Moonshot, etc.)  |  | (DeepSeek, OpenR.) |  |   Bedrock, Vertex) |  |
        |  +--------------------+  +--------------------+  +--------------------+  |
        +-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 1.1 Direct Provider Launch vs. Unified Gateway Mode

- **Direct Provider Launch (`crouter <provider> [model] [args...]`)**:
  - Starts a dedicated, local-only `keypool-proxy` on an ephemeral or allocated loopback port.
  - Injects audited provider defaults: base model, Opus/Sonnet/Haiku/Subagent tier mappings, context window caps, reasoning effort levels, and session MCP plugins.
  - Sanitizes the runtime environment using `env -i`, passing only essential OS environment variables and authorized credentials.
  - Automatically terminates proxy processes when Claude Code exits.
- **Unified Gateway Mode (`crouter all`)**:
  - Starts `bin/gateway` listening on `127.0.0.1:18799` (customizable via `CROUTER_GATEWAY_PORT`).
  - Synthesizes all configured providers into a unified `/v1/models` catalog where every model ID is namespaced (e.g. `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, `dashscope/qwen3.8-max`, `openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`).
  - Allows live model switching inside an active Claude Code session via the `/model <provider>/<model>` command without restarting the agent.
  - Authenticates local clients using a cryptographically randomized per-session token (`CROUTER_GATEWAY_TOKEN`).

---

## 2. Failover Engine & Error Code Matrix

`crouter` implements a unified failover engine shared across `bin/keypool-proxy`, `bin/gateway`, and `lib/proxy-common.js`.

### 2.1 HTTP Status Code Matrix

| Status Code | Classification | Action | Cooldown Triggered | Retry on Same Candidate? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **401 Unauthorized** | Expired/Revoked Key | Immediate Failover to next candidate | Yes (300s base) | No |
| **402 Payment Required** | Balance/Quota Exhaustion | Immediate Failover to next candidate | Yes (300s base) | No |
| **403 Forbidden** | Entitlement/Plan Inactive | Immediate Failover to next candidate | Yes (300s base) | No |
| **429 Too Many Requests** | Rate Limit Exceeded | Immediate Failover to next candidate | Yes (`Retry-After` or 300s) | No |
| **500 - 599 Server Error** | Upstream Provider Glitch | Retry on same candidate up to 2 times | Yes (on persistent failure) | Yes (exponential backoff: 400ms, 800ms) |
| **Network Blip / Timeout** | TCP Reset / Hangup | Retry on same candidate up to 2 times | Yes (on persistent failure) | Yes (exponential backoff) |

### 2.2 Cooldown Calculation Formula

When an upstream endpoint responds with an exhausting HTTP status code, `crouter` calculates the unavailability timestamp:

$$\text{cooldownMs} = \max\left(\text{CROUTER\_CANDIDATE\_COOLDOWN\_MS},\, \text{parseRetryAfter}(\text{headers})\right)$$

- **Default Base Cooldown**: `300000 ms` (5 minutes). Configurable via `CROUTER_CANDIDATE_COOLDOWN_MS`.
- **`Retry-After` Header Parsing**:
  - Decimal or Integer Seconds: parsed into milliseconds (`seconds * 1000`).
  - HTTP Date String: parsed into milliseconds relative to current wall-clock time (`Date.parse(header) - Date.now()`).
- **Candidate Reordering**:
  - Candidates whose cooldown has expired (`unavailableUntil <= now`) remain active in original priority order.
  - Candidates currently cooling down (`unavailableUntil > now`) are sorted by earliest availability and appended to the **tail** of the candidate list.
  - If all candidates are cooling down, the engine falls back to the candidate with the earliest expiring cooldown as a last-resort recovery mechanism.
  - Successful requests execute `clear(candidateIndex)`, resetting cooldown tracking.

### 3.2 In-Depth Provider Specifications

#### 1. DeepSeek (`deepseek`)
- **Base Endpoint**: `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic`
- **Auth Mode**: `surfaces` (API Surface). Header: `x-api-key`.
- **Environment Variables**: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. Keychain: `deepseek-api-key`.
- **Model Tiers**:
  - Primary / Sonnet / Haiku / Subagent: `deepseek-flash`
  - Opus: `deepseek-v4-pro`
  - Self-Route / Aliases: `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro`, `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4.1`, `deepseek-flash[1m]`.
- **Context & Compaction**: Context Window = 1,000,000 tokens; Auto-Compaction Window = 786,432 tokens. Effort = `max`.
- **Managed Assets**: Native server-side web search tool integration; strict MCP profile.

#### 2. MiniMax (`minimax`)
- **Base Endpoint**: `https://api.minimax.cn/anthropic`
- **Auth Mode**: `surfaces` (Token Plan vs API Key). Header: `Bearer`.
- **Plan Credentials**: Env: `MINIMAX_TOKEN_PLAN_KEY`. Keychain: `codex-minimax-token-plan`.
- **API Credentials**: Env: `MINIMAX_API_KEY`. Keychain: `minimax-api-key`.
- **Model Tiers**:
  - Plan Surface: `MiniMax-M3` across Opus/Sonnet/Haiku/Subagent.
  - API Surface: `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` / `MiniMax-M3`.
- **Context Window**: 1,000,000 tokens. Auto-Compaction = 1,000,000 tokens. Effort = `max`.
- **Managed Assets**: `minimax-coding-plan-mcp==0.0.4` via `uvx`, plus session-scoped `minimax-cli` skill (`mmx-cli@1.0.19`).

#### 3. DashScope - Alibaba Model Studio (`dashscope`)
- **Base Endpoint (Plan)**: `https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic`
- **Base Endpoint (API)**: `${DASHSCOPE_API_URL:-https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic}`
- **Auth Mode**: `surfaces`. Header: `Bearer`.
- **Plan Credentials**: Env: `DASHSCOPE_TOKEN_PLAN_KEY`. Keychain: `dashscope-token-plan`.
- **API Credentials**: Env: `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY`. Keychain: `dashscope-api-key`.
- **Model Tiers**:
  - Plan Surface: `qwen3.8-max` (Opus/Sonnet), `qwen3.6-flash` (Haiku), `qwen3.7-max` (Subagent).
  - API Surface: `qwen3.7-max` (Opus/Sonnet/Subagent), `qwen3.6-flash` (Haiku).
- **Context Window**: 983,616 tokens. Auto-Compaction = 983,616 tokens. Effort = `xhigh`.
- **Managed Assets**:
  - Token Plan: namespaced media skill for image/video/speech endpoints.
  - API Key: official Model Studio WebSearch MCP.

#### 4. DashScope Coding Plan (`dashscope-coding`)
- **Base Endpoint**: `https://coding.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/apps/anthropic`
- **Auth Mode**: `surfaces` (Dedicated Coding Plan Surface). Header: `Bearer`.
- **Credentials**: Env: `DASHSCOPE_CODING_PLAN_KEY`. Keychain: `dashscope-coding-plan`.
- **Model**: `qwen3.7-plus`. Context: 983,616 tokens. Effort = `xhigh`.

#### 5. Moonshot / Kimi Code (`moonshot`)
- **Base Endpoint**: `https://api.kimi.com/coding/`
- **Auth Mode**: `surfaces`. Header: `x-api-key`.
- **Credentials**: Env: `KIMI_CODE_KEY` (fallback: `MOONSHOT_API_KEY`). Keychain: `moonshot-coding-1`.
- **Model Tiers**: Primary: `k3-256k`. Aliases: `k3[1m]`, `kimi-k3`, `kimi-k3.1-pro`.
- **Context Window**: 262,144 tokens (`k3-256k`) or 1,000,000 tokens (`k3[1m]`). Effort = `high`.

#### 6. SiliconFlow (`siliconflow`)
- **Base Endpoint**: `https://api.siliconflow.cn`
- **Auth Mode**: `surfaces`. Header: `Bearer`.
- **Credentials**: Env: `SILICONFLOW_API_KEY`. Keychain: `siliconflow-api-key`.
- **Model Tiers**: Opus/Sonnet/Subagent: `Pro/moonshotai/Kimi-K2.7-Code`. Haiku: `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`.
- **Context Window**: Up to 1,000,000 tokens via overrides. Effort = `high`.

#### 7. OpenRouter (`openrouter`)
- **Base Endpoint**: `https://openrouter.ai/api`
- **Auth Mode**: `env`. Header: `Bearer`.
- **Credentials**: Env: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. Keychain: `openrouter-api-key`.
- **Dynamic Catalog**: Caches 400+ models locally at `~/.local/state/crouter/models-openrouter.json` with 24-hour TTL.
- **Default Model**: `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free`.
- **Context Window**: 1,000,000 tokens (Nemotron), 262,144 tokens (`qwen/qwen3.8-27b`). Effort = `max`.

#### 8. Ollama Local Inference (`ollama`)
- **Base Endpoint**: `http://127.0.0.1:11435` (Internal Heartbeat Relay). Upstream Ollama: `127.0.0.1:11434`.
- **Auth Mode**: `none` (Loopback authentication token: `ollama`).
- **Default Model**: `qwen3.8:27b-dflash` (262,144 context, effort `xhigh`).
- **Heartbeat Proxy Features**:
  - Emits SSE comment keepalives (`: keepalive`) every 60 seconds during multi-minute tool execution.
  - Converts DeepSeek-V4 vision blocks into textual fallback descriptions, avoiding missing-`mmproj` HTTP 500 fatal errors.
  - Normalizes thinking mode between Anthropic parameters and local Ollama toggles.

#### 9. Anthropic Console (`anthropic`)
- **Base Endpoint**: `https://api.anthropic.com`
- **Auth Mode**: `env`. Header: `x-api-key`.
- **Credentials**: Env: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Keychain: `anthropic-api-key`.
- **Model Tiers**: Opus: `claude-opus-5-5`. Sonnet: `claude-sonnet-5`. Haiku: `claude-haiku-4-5`.
- **Isolation Note**: Official subscription OAuth (`crouter claude`) is strictly separated from Console API billing (`crouter anthropic`).

- **Foundry**: Env: `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY=1`, `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE`, Azure credential chain.

---

## 4. CLI Command Reference

### 4.1 Launching & Execution

```sh
# Launch current persistent target
crouter
crouter run [claude-args...]

# Launch specific provider with optional model override
crouter <provider>
crouter <provider> <model> [claude-args...]
crouter deepseek
crouter dashscope qwen3.8-max
crouter openrouter --model nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free

# Unified Gateway Mode (Dynamic live routing)
crouter all                  # Start gateway and launch Claude Code
crouter all --check          # Redacted dry-run route audit (no network requests)
```

### 4.2 Target Selection & Persistence

```sh
crouter use                  # Print current persistent target
crouter use minimax          # Persistently select MiniMax provider
crouter use app/codex        # Persistently select native Codex CLI
crouter use --clear          # Remove persistent target selection
```
*Persistent state is saved to mode-600 file `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/crouter/selection`.*

### 4.3 Catalog & Inspection

```sh
crouter list                 # List providers runnable immediately on this machine
crouter list --all           # List full catalog (shows missing-key routes as no-key)
crouter list keys <provider> # List registered Keychain / env keys for provider
crouter provider show <name> # Inspect provider URLs, auth headers, and model maps
crouter <provider> --browse  # Interactive terminal TUI model selector
crouter <provider> --browse --apply-only  # Save model selection without launching
```

### 4.4 Credential & Keypool Management

```sh
# Add keys to macOS Keychain
crouter add                  # Interactive menu of unconfigured providers
crouter add --all            # Menu covering all providers for rotation
crouter add minimax --surface plan
crouter add minimax --surface api
pass show minimax/plan | crouter add minimax --surface plan --stdin

# Remove keys
crouter remove minimax --surface api --name minimax-api-2
```

### 4.5 Diagnostics & Logs

```sh
crouter doctor               # Full environment and toolchain diagnosis
crouter doctor <provider>    # Probe credential presence and health check URL
crouter config show          # Inspect normalized config flags (secrets masked)
crouter config path          # Locate local config.sh file
crouter logs list            # List session log files
crouter logs tail <provider> # Stream real-time provider logs
crouter --version            # Print version string
```

### 4.6 Encrypted Migration (`migrate`)

```sh
# Export encrypted package (AES-256-GCM + scrypt)
crouter migrate export ~/crouter.crm
cat passphrase.txt | crouter migrate export ~/crouter.crm --password-stdin

# Import package onto new machine
crouter migrate import ~/crouter.crm
crouter migrate import ~/crouter.crm --portable   # Skip Keychain on Linux/headless

# Verify package integrity without executing code
crouter migrate verify ~/crouter.crm
```

### 4.7 Native Coding-Agent CLI Multiplexer (`app`)

`crouter app <name> [args...]` dispatches directly to installed coding-agent CLIs, bypassing `config.sh` and provider proxies:
- `crouter app list`: Check installation status of supported agent CLIs.
- Supported agents: `claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `opencode`, `copilot`, `cursor`, `kiro`, `qoder`, `kimi`, `qwen`, `amp`, `vibe`, `muse`, `kilo`.

---

## 5. Security & Isolation Model

### 5.1 Environment Sanitization (`env -i`)

When launching Claude Code or child processes, `lib/launch.sh` constructs a sterile environment:
- Drops all parent shell variables (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, residual tokens, AWS keys, custom aliases).
- Whitelists only essential terminal variables: `LANG`, `TERM`, `SHELL`, `PATH`, `USER`, `HOME`, `COLORTERM`.
- Injects only provider-declared variables (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, session client token, model overrides).
- Restricts passthrough environment variables for native cloud SDKs (`AWS_*`, `GOOGLE_*`, `AZURE_*`) strictly to provider manifests.

### 5.2 macOS Keychain Storage Architecture

- Keys are added directly via macOS `security add-generic-password` with terminal echo disabled.
- Standard service names: `crouter-<provider>-plan`, `crouter-<provider>-api`.
- User-added pooled keys receive deterministic service names registered in `.state/keypools/<provider>.json` (mode 600).
- Secrets are NEVER printed to stdout, stderr, debug logs, or command-line argument lists.

### 5.3 Local Loopback Proxy Token Protection

- Local proxies (`keypool-proxy`, `gateway`) bind strictly to `127.0.0.1`.
- Every direct or unified session generates a cryptographically random, per-session client token.
- Local requests missing the authorization token receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized, preventing cross-process token hijacking on multi-user or shared workstations.

### 5.4 Session-Scoped Ephemeral MCP Isolation

- By default, `crouter` passes `--strict-mcp-config`, creating a temporary mode-600 configuration file.
- Disables ambient or project-level MCP definitions to prevent tool pollution or accidental credential leakage between different provider plans.
- Temporary configurations and sockets are deleted immediately upon agent session termination (`POST_STOP` traps).

---

## 6. Coding Agent & IDE Integration Guide

### 6.1 Anthropic Claude Code CLI
Claude Code is the primary first-class client:
```sh
# Method A: Direct wrapper (recommended)
crouter deepseek
crouter minimax
crouter all

# Method B: Exporting environment variables for standalone Claude Code
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:18799"
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="crouter"
claude
# Inside Claude Code:
/model deepseek/deepseek-flash
/model dashscope/qwen3.8-max
```

### 6.2 Cursor & Cursor Agent
Cursor can route model calls through `crouter` via custom OpenAI/Anthropic endpoint settings:
1. Start unified gateway in terminal: `crouter all --check` (or run daemon).
2. Open Cursor Settings -> Models -> Add Custom Model.
3. Override Anthropic Base URL:
   - Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:18799`
   - API Key: `crouter` (or session token)
4. Dispatch Cursor CLI Agent:
   ```sh
   crouter app cursor [args...]
   ```

### 6.3 OpenAI Codex CLI
1. Codex CLI can be executed with native authentication:
   ```sh
   crouter app codex [args...]
   ```
2. Or persistent selection:
   ```sh
   crouter use app/codex
   crouter run
   ```
3. To route Claude Code through ChatGPT subscription:
   ```sh
   crouter codex
   ```

### 6.4 Windsurf / Codeium
1. Navigate to Windsurf Settings -> AI Provider Configuration.
2. Select Anthropic Compatible Gateway.
3. Set Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:18799`
4. Set API Key: `crouter`
5. Model Name: `deepseek/deepseek-flash` or `dashscope/qwen3.8-max`.

### 6.5 Cline (VS Code Extension)
1. Open Cline extension settings in VS Code.
2. Set API Provider to `Anthropic Compatible` or `Claude`.
3. Set Custom Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:18799`
4. Set Anthropic API Key: `crouter`
5. Specify namespaced Model ID: `minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` or `openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`.

---

## 7. Operational Troubleshooting & Runbook

### 7.1 "Port already in use" (EADDRINUSE)
- **Symptom**: `keypool-proxy: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 127.0.0.1:18799`
- **Cause**: A previous gateway process did not shut down cleanly.
- **Resolution**:
  ```sh
  lsof -i :18799 -sTCP:LISTEN -t | xargs kill -9
  ```

### 7.2 "All auth candidates failed" (HTTP 502)
- **Symptom**: Agent receives HTTP 502 with `{"error":{"type":"all_candidates_failed"}}`
- **Cause**: Every key in the configured surface pool returned 401, 402, 403, or 429 and entered cooldown.
- **Resolution**:
  1. Inspect status with `crouter doctor <provider>`.
  2. Verify balance on vendor console.
  3. Add or rotate a fresh key: `crouter add <provider> --surface <plan|api>`.

### 7.3 Keychain Access Denied / Headless Linux
- **Symptom**: `security: SecKeychainSearchCopyNext: The user canceled or denied the request`
- **Cause**: Running in headless SSH or non-interactive CI without unlocked macOS Keychain.
- **Resolution**:
  - Export credentials as environment variables (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=...`).
  - Or use portable migration storage: `crouter migrate import backup.crm --portable`.

### 7.4 Hermetic Test Suite Verification
Verify all provider routing surfaces and contracts without network access:
```sh
for shell in sh dash; do
  for test_file in test/*.sh; do "$shell" "$test_file"; done
done
for file in bin/gateway bin/keypool-proxy lib/*.js lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$file"; done
```
